title: The GaoYao Benchmark: A Comprehensive Framework for Evaluating Multilingual and Multicultural Abilities of Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing language model performance across 26 languages of varying resource levels (high, medium, low) and geographic regions across nine cognitive evaluation sub-layers to identify performance disparities and the 'digital divide'.

Evaluating models on monocultural and cross-cultural tasks via multiple-choice questions and open-ended QA (using the synthesized SUPERBLEND, SAGE, and CULTURESCOPE datasets) to measure their understanding of culturally specific concepts and shared nuances across 34 distinct cultures.
